label: Post-infectious Basal Ganglia Encephalitis Caused by Mumps: A Case Series.
summary: BackgroundMumps is a highly neurotropic virus causing a wide variety of neurologic complications. Post-/para-infectious basal ganglia encephalitis is one of its rare complications, with higher morbidity compared with other complications.CasesWe present 5 cases with basal ganglia encephalitis secondary to mumps infection.
